meta.scope: F1 circuit, pit lane, low smooth kerbs, markings, tidied astroturf and gravel; buildings and stands excluded; broad model-derived grass slopes and foundation

pitLane.layout: Longest connected medial path of the named pitlane mesh, smoothed, widened and joined to the main road. Core retained; entry and exit replaced with gradual tangent curves. Overlapping pit connectors share the main road plane, then blend back over 40 studs of lateral separation.

limitations: Supplied GLB surface reconstruction, not a surveyed or exact 2026 layout; the AC extension is missing its base Monza files.
The display tilt is removed. Broad hills and banking are retained, with distance-based height and banking smoothing for gentler crests.
Kerb placement and colours come from the model; the width and low ramp profile are adapted for driving.
Runoff is a simplified, tidied projection onto the widened circuit; small grass slivers are filled.
Rectangular pieces have small overlaps and angular perimeter edges. Surface joins and live vehicle handling still need in-game validation.
Standing anchor maps horizontal pit position; elevated pit pavement can be above your feet. Lowest surfaces clear the grass by 0.25 studs.
Terrain uses broad sloping boxes rather than every model crest. Perimeter corners and terrace seams remain visible; high-detail scenery is excluded.

surfaceSmoothing.method: Distance-weighted Gaussian, five-sigma support; height and banking only
